unit.why: A single anecdote about the Ropshitzer (Rymanów rabbi) perceiving two visiting hasidim's critical thoughts and their punishment, quoted from an earlier book with a closing moral.

stories.start_quote: והיה מעשה אצל הק׳ מרומנאב שבאו
stories.end_quote: משליך אותם לשאול תחתית ודי בזה
stories.summary_en: Two hasidim of the Lelów tzaddik visiting the rebbe of Rymanów inwardly doubt his prayer on Friday night. He feels their thought, has his attendant R. Zvi bar them from the study house, and they are struck with incurable boils. The text closes with a warning that hasidim must never question a tzaddik.
